name: Texas A&M University
summary: Two pickup companies publish a Texas A&M page: Collegeboxes and Dorm Room Movers. Local storage is a separate choice, rented directly from facilities in College Station and Bryan.
independenceNote: Move-Out Desk is not Texas A&M and not a storage company. Collegeboxes prints that it has no active partnership with Texas A&M University, College Station. Nothing here is an official university move-out service.
